content: Our own render on 2026-11-17: React Vibe's Branch Flow (siddhantmani/reactvibe public/Motion/BranchFlow/BranchFlow.tsx, README says MIT) copied into a fresh Vite 7.3 + React 19.2 + Tailwind 4.3 project and screenshotted in headless Chrome 2.6 s into the animation, plus our own grep/build output. One sample icon in that file draws a third-party brand logo; in our render it was replaced by a plain dot so the cover carries no third-party logo. No React Vibe site UI or logo.
